C0555.title: Man Sentenced for 2,700+ Fraudulent Refund-Only Claims via Malicious Ordering
C0555.summary: An individual targeted over 900 merchants by placing more than 2,700 malicious orders and subsequently filing refund-only requests, exploiting platform refund policies to obtain goods or monetary benefits. The act was deemed fraud, resulting in a one-and-a-half-year prison sentence.

references.title: Man Repeatedly Applied for Refund Only, Maliciously Placed Over 2,700 Orders from Over 900 Merchants, Sentenced to 1.5 Years
